class SuperFlowBase { constructor(public value = 1) {} }
class OneSuperBranch extends SuperFlowBase { constructor(flag: boolean) { if (flag) super(); console.log(this.value); } }
class OtherSuperBranch extends SuperFlowBase { constructor(flag: boolean) { if (flag) super(); else console.log(this.value); } }
class BeforeSuperBranch extends SuperFlowBase { constructor(flag: boolean) { console.log(this.value); if (flag) super(); else super(); } }
class NestedSuperArrow extends SuperFlowBase { constructor() { const call = () => super(); call(); console.log(this.value); } }
class ReadingSuperArgument extends SuperFlowBase { constructor() { super(this.value); } }
